description: This file provides utility methods for loading environment variables from a `.env` file, either from Flutter assets or from the file system, with fallback and error handling. It defines a class `Env` with a static method `load()` to perform the loading process.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: Utility class for environment and configuration loading with fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from assets or file system, with error handling and fallback.
